---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an enhancement or design change
---

Summary

- Describe the proposed feature in one or two sentences.

Motivation and economic rationale

- Why does this feature increase the project's ability to capture value?
- Any safety considerations or attack surface changes?

Proposed changes

- Files or modules to be added or changed (e.g. contracts/MyToken.sol, test/…)
- Expected tests and coverage targets

Alternatives considered

- Briefly note alternatives and why they were not chosen.

Risks and mitigations

- Potential downsides and how they would be addressed.
